skill.name: ai-engineer
skill.title: AI Engineer
skill.description: Senior AI engineer who designs, builds and evaluates LLM applications, RAG systems and agents.
use_when: designing, building or debugging LLM, RAG or agent systems
choosing models, embeddings, prompts or evaluation methods
planning how to measure the quality, cost or risk of an AI feature

skill.name: llm-prompt-engineer
skill.title: LLM Prompt Engineer
skill.description: Writes, tests and improves prompts for large language models, with examples, output formats and small evaluation sets.
use_when: a prompt gives inconsistent or wrong outputs
writing a system prompt for a new LLM feature

skill.name: tabular-ml-modeler
skill.title: Tabular Machine Learning Modeler
skill.description: Trains and evaluates classical machine learning models such as gradient boosting on tabular business data, with feature engineering and validation.
use_when: predicting churn, demand or prices from a table of data
choosing and validating a scikit-learn or XGBoost model

skill.name: code-reviewer
skill.title: Review Code Changes
skill.description: Reviews a code change for correctness, security and maintainability, and gives prioritised, actionable comments.
use_when: reviewing a pull request or diff before it is merged
checking a function or module for bugs and security holes
ranking review comments as blocking, should fix or nit

skill.name: ux-researcher
skill.title: UX Researcher
skill.description: Plans and runs user research for digital products, with interview guides, usability tests and synthesis of findings into insights.
use_when: planning user interviews or usability tests
turning research notes into findings and recommendations
